title: Ethical Business Practices: Amanah (Trust) in Trade
description: Business ethics in Islam: honest dealings, trust (amanah), promises, and character — what ethical practice looks like from the Qur'an and Sunnah, delivered by Salafi scholars. Ustadh AbdelRahman Murphy, Ummee Khadeejah, Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem, and قناة زاد الفضائية.
short_description: The honest trader's code: Quran, Sunnah & ethics of business

lessons.content: The ethical foundations of Islamic business: intention, halal earnings, mercy in transactions. Ustadh AbdelRahman Murphy, Firm Believer in Islam.
